title: InstancePost represents the fields required to rename/move a LXD instance.

Config.description:
Instance configuration file.

API extension: instance_move_config

Profiles.description:
List of profiles applied to the instance.

API extension: instance_move_config

allow_inconsistent.description:
AllowInconsistent allow inconsistent copies when migrating.

API extension: instance_allow_inconsistent_copy

container_only.description:
Whether snapshots should be discarded (migration only, deprecated, use instance_only)

Deprecated: use InstanceOnly.

instance_only.description: Whether snapshots should be discarded (migration only)

live.description: Whether to perform a live migration (migration only)

migration.description: Whether the instance is being migrated to another server

override_snapshot_profiles.description:
Whether the instances's snapshot should receive target instances profile on copy

API extension: override_snapshot_profiles_on_copy

pool.description:
Target pool for local cross-pool move

API extension: instance_pool_move

project.description:
Target project for local cross-project move

API extension: instance_project_move

certificate.description: The certificate of the migration target

operation.description: The operation URL on the remote target

InstancePostTarget.title: InstancePostTarget represents the migration target host and operation.
